scope: Source-only review of local follow-up merge helper; not execution or approval of any future manifest
verified: Clean exact candidate/base and checked-out main; ancestry required
Independent PASS report file hash plus exact reviewed revision; builder/reviewer identities bound to report and distinct
Coverage map comes exactly from report; bytes compared at reviewed and merge revisions; full changed-path set equality
Typed Core implementation/QA records with exact commit and host-independent provenance; require_pass
Final mutation within shared product lease and Ledger.gate control-row lock; base/branch/clean rechecked
Latest QA and exact recorded QA ID rechecked within held merge gate
Bounded ff-only merge of checked-out main, post-merge exact revision and clean check; output marked PASS only afterward
resolved_findings: Coverage and reviewer identity originally trusted caller fields without exact report binding
Final source/control checks originally outside shared lease/control transaction
Latest QA originally checked only before acquiring merge lease
limits: No helper execution, database writes, Git mutation or fake independent verdict occurred in this review.
Run with ordinary Python assertions enabled, as the reviewed helper uses assert for preconditions.
Lease serializes canonical product execution; unrelated external Git edits do not participate, so Git locks and post-checks remain additional safeguards.
A failing/timeout Git operation retains GATED rather than PASS evidence and requires operator reconciliation.
Each later manifest still requires exact independent source/report coverage; this helper review cannot authorize unreviewed code.
